question: Is there an independently dated record that the acceptance criteria A1-A9b existed before the Phase 2 test evaluations?
method: Google Drive file metadata (createdTime, modifiedTime) read through the Drive API on 6 Nov 2026; one notebook copy downloaded and parsed; no file content was altered.

records.what: 05_integration.ipynb (original notebook file in the project Drive folder)
records.note: creation time is independent evidence that the notebook file existed on 15 Oct; its content was modified later, so this record alone does not show which criteria it held on 15 Oct

records.content: all ten criteria present with the final targets: A1 acc>=0.90, A2 macro-F1>=0.90, A3 mAP50>=0.75, A4 recall>=0.80, A5 mIoU>=0.75, A6 Dice>=0.85, A7 success>=0.99, A8 p95<=2000 ms, A9a<=0.001, A9b<=0.001; 0 executed cells
records.note: modifiedTime is the file's own timestamp preserved by Drive when the copy was uploaded on 24 Oct; it is weaker than a createdTime but was not set by the team by hand
first executed integration run that filled the acceptance table
lists the Phase 2 targets as team-stated targets; dated after the Phase 2 test runs, so not prespecification evidence
first commit 6263632 on 31 Oct 2026; no Git record earlier than the runs

conclusion: The criteria with their final targets are present in an unexecuted notebook copy dated 18 Oct 2026 11:19 UTC, before the executed integration/test runs of 19 Oct 2026 (00:47 and 09:18 UTC). No independently dated record earlier than 18 Oct carries the criteria text; the team's statement that they were written on 15 Oct is supported only by the creation time of the notebook file (15 Oct 16:55 UTC), whose content changed later. The first detector training run (17 Oct) precedes the earliest dated copy of the criteria text.
limitations: Drive modifiedTime of an uploaded copy can in principle be set by the uploading client; W&B run creation times were not read (no key in this session); the instructor's topic-approval message was not located (mail connector not authorised in this session).
owner_actions: locate the instructor's approval message of 19 Oct 2026 and keep a dated copy privately
explain in the report how a first run on 17 Oct precedes the approval of 19 Oct, or correct one of the dates from original records
